text_blocks.snippet: Stage IA endometrial cancer means the cancer is found within the uterus, specifically in the endometrium (lining of the uterus) or has spread less than halfway through the myometrium (muscle layer of the uterus). It has not spread to the lymph nodes or other parts of the body.

text_blocks.snippet: Key points about Stage IA endometrial cancer:

list.title: Limited Spread:
list.snippet: The cancer is confined to the uterus, specifically the endometrium or a small portion of the myometrium.

list.title: No Lymph Node Involvement:
list.snippet: Crucially, the cancer cells have not spread to the lymph nodes, which is a positive prognostic factor.
